data.about: I build engineering capabilities that help software teams do the best work of their lives.Across Microsoft, Expeditors, Niantic, Epic Games, and my current AI software factory work, my career has followed one pattern: I enter environments with ambiguity, fragmented systems, manual workflows, unreliable signals, or broken stakeholder trust. I listen, identify friction, create clarity, deliver early wins, and turn repeated problems into reusable engineering capabilities.ACHIEVEMENTS / IMPACTAt Epic Games◆ Scaled Platform Engineering from 5 to 40 engineers across the US, Canada, Europe, and LATAM while maintaining zero regrettable attrition through restructuring and industry-wide gaming layoffs.◆ Secured and managed a $2.2M annual engineering investment and delivered $5.5M+ in documented impact through internal developer platforms, release readiness systems, CI/CD modernization, validation automation, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.◆ Built AI-assisted workflows on Epic’s internal LLM platform: blame-change identification at ~80% accuracy, failure triage at ~70% accuracy, and Build Insights, which reached 300 daily active users across QA, Release Management, Technical Art, and Engineering.◆ Delivered the Cosmetic Validation Platform, enabling nightly automated visual validation across 10 platforms with self-service web/API access for eight engineering teams and approximately $3M in savings.◆ Modernized CI/CD across 10 platforms and 14 automated test suites, improving execution by 46%, reclaiming 60,000+ build-agent hours annually, and improving suite stability by 70%.At Niantic◆ Joined as the founding Development Productivity engineer for Pokémon GO and built CI/CD, Kubernetes deployment, pre-merge validation, API automation, device validation, and platform versioning from the ground up.CORPORATE◆ 15+ years building engineering capabilities across Microsoft, Expeditors, Niantic, Epic Games, and AI software factory work.◆ Focus areas: Platform Engineering, Developer Experience, Engineering Productivity, Internal Developer Platforms, AI-enabled engineering workflows, and engineering transformation.AI Software Factory https://github.com/deepkawal/software-factory  Reusable agent-based software delivery system using specialized AI agents, shared domain experts, Architecture Decision Records, Product Decisions, quality gates, and human-in-the-loop governance.OUTSIDE WORK◆ Founder & Leader, Har Sewa Foundation, supporting medical and educational needs.◆ Member, Bellevue School District CTE Advisory Committee.

description.text:
LLM-POWERED DEVELOPER WORKFLOWS
Conceived and led delivery of internal LLM APIs for blame-change identification (80%) and failure triage (70%) — consumed as self-service by Release, QA/Validation teams.
Conceived and shipped Build Insight - LLM-powered tool summarizing code change lists for non-technical audiences (QA, Release Mgmt, Tech Art), recommending test focus, flagging release risks. 300 daily active users across cross-functional teams.

LAUNCH READINESS & DECISION SYSTEMS
Conceived and led delivery of a unified ELT + Tableau platform aggregating manual validation, automation failures, P0/P1 signals, build health, and CI/CD pipeline stability. 15+ functional leaders use the dashboards for release decisions; same data layer exposed via API for downstream tooling.

INTERNAL DEVELOPER PLATFORMS - 8 self-service reliable platforms serving 4000 engineers/non engineers.
• Cosmetic Validation -$3M savings on $10M+ visual quality problem; 8 teams self-serve
• Cosmetic Performance Automation -10,000+ cosmetics across Epic’s title portfolio
• UEFN Platform -1,000+ external third-party developers; caught multiple P0/P1s bugs pre-release
• SmartBot & Multiplayer Perf Framework -125-person offshore team self-serves; ~$2M avoided cost
• Crash Reporter & HitchHunter -auto-detect/route crashes across 10+ teams; 2,000 QA hours saved annually
• CI/CD Pipeline & Build Infra - Fortnite nightly pipeline accelerated 46% across 10 platforms / 14 test suites; 60,000+ agent hours reclaimed, ~$500K savings
ORG & IMPACT
Scaled the team across US, Canada, Europe, LATAM(with 0 regrettable attrition) | $2.2M annual vendor budget | $5.5M+ documented engineering efficiency savings

experiences.title: Founding Engineer, Development Productivity, Platform Engineering | Pokemon Go
experiences.subtitle: Niantic, Inc. . Full-time
experiences.caption: Feb 2018 - Jul 2023 · 5 yrs 5 mos

description.text:
Developer Productivity Foundations
•  Built the core engineering productivity foundation for Pokemon GO, including GitLab-based CI/CD infrastructure and GCP/Kubernetes deployment workflows supporting globally distributed backend services.
•  Created a one-click GCP and Kubernetes server deployment capability that eliminated recurring manual environment setup, reduced developer dependency on support channels, and helped engineering teams get unblocked without filing tickets.
•  Defined and delivered self-service pre-merge validation in GitLab CI/CD, enabling developers to catch integration issues before code merged into main and reducing reliance on manual QA coordination.
•  Conceived the Bill of Materials versioning strategy for Niantic shared multi-game platform, built stakeholder alignment across engineering organizations, and partnered with Platform Engineering to operationalize the capability.
Automation & Developer Self-Service
•  Architected and built an API automation framework from scratch, eliminating more than 8,000 manual testing hours annually and delivering approximately $400K in savings while improving confidence in server-side validation.
•  Engineered concurrent-session validation for complex multiplayer gameplay, including Raid-related workflows, saving approximately 1,200 engineering hours annually and enabling more realistic validation of high-concurrency player experiences.
Device Validation & Organizational Influence
•  Established Niantic enterprise device validation capability by selecting HeadSpin, expanding on-premises iOS device capacity from 4 to 48 devices and negotiating vendor agreements that reduced annual operating costs by more than $200K.
•  Defined and presented the engineering productivity strategy and quarterly roadmap to executive leadership, influencing investment priorities and creating visibility for developer productivity as an engineering capability.
•  Grew the Development Productivity function from 1 to 3 engineers,

Founded and built the organization's first structured test automation framework . Designed the framework architecture end-to-end, covering API and UI automation layers, and integrated it into CI/CD for continuous self-service testing across the org.

This was my first 0→1 build and the role that sharpened my conviction that engineering effectiveness has to be built intentionally; it doesn't happen on its own. The pattern carried forward to Niantic, where I founded Development Productivity from scratch.

WHAT I BUILT

Designed and delivered end-to-end automation framework from scratch in Java, establishing the foundation for scalable, repeatable validation across teams. Integrated framework into CI/CD pipeline, enabling continuous testing without manual coordination. Introduced standardized testing and release processes that reduced production risk and improved consistency across the engineering organization.

description.text:
Three roles spanning my time on Microsoft programs — Office 365 via HCL Technologies, then SDET II at MSN, then SDE II at Excel . This is where I built my technical foundation across automation, CI/CD, and cross-platform engineering at enterprise scale

SDE II , EXCEL (2014–2016)
led delivery of new worksheet functions across Windows, Android, and Office Online; designed a function API that cut code redundancy ~90%.
SDET II, MSN (2013–2014)
Supported 24x7 on-call operations for MSN on Azure — a high-availability, globally distributed consumer platform serving millions of users. Increased automation coverage by 40% and reduced execution time by 30%. Designed localization automation solution adopted across all MSN apps. Built API automation for Cortana & Bing Travel, cutting testing time from days to hours.

TEST LEAD, OFFICE 365 (2010–2013, via HCL Technologies)
Led HCL test team of 8 engineers delivering Live@Edu → Office 365 (Azure) migration validation for a globally distributed, enterprise-grade SaaS platform across 27 locales. Achieved 70%+ automation coverage using Page Object Model. Extended solution to Office 365 web portal validation at global scale.

description.text:
A reusable agentic software factory: a multi-agent build pipeline plus the shared, cross-project assets that keep it honest. One source of truth, installed into whichever agent/CLI runs the work. Every project (rig) imports from here; project-specific decisions stay in each project repo.

The pipeline (packs/core-factory/) is a Gas City pack of 10 cooperating agents — intake/PM → planner → architect → designer → builder → product / architecture / code reviewers → validator → release-gate — wired to the domain experts, engineering rules, and decision-record discipline in this repo.
